articles.summary: Crescent Energy Company (NYSE: CRGY) today announced plans to host a conference call and webcast at 10 a.m. CT, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The Company plans to release results after market close on Monday, November 2, 2026. The earnings release, supplemental slides and live webcast will be available through the Investors section of the Company’s website at www.crescentenergyco.com . Conference Call Information Time: 10 a.m. CT
articles.title: Crescent Energy Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
